summary: Retest of the reconnect bug (technician close-X then re-open 'Ver/Reconectar' -> black video). All scenarios PASS. Verified 3 consecutive close/reopen cycles + first open + btn-pedir-reconexao + click-ripple regression. No JS errors, no pageerrors, no 'iceReady is not defined' or 'io is not defined'.
critical_code_review_comments: tecnico.js abrirVer() now correctly closes prior pc, resets remotoPronto/iceQueue and clears video-ecra.srcObject before emitting tecnico:ver + tecnico:pedir-reconexao — reconnect flow stable across multiple cycles.
aoReceberOferta() binds ontrack/onicecandidate/oniceconnectionstatechange to pcLocal and guards with `if (pc !== pcLocal) return;` — prevents stale handlers from writing to a new pc instance.
fecharModal() mirrors the cleanup used in abrirVer() (pc.close, srcObject=null, remotoPronto=false, iceQueue=[]), ensuring state is deterministic on reopen.
seed_data_creation: None (a new session was created in historico).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse the getDisplayMedia stub via context.add_init_script (canvas.captureStream(10)) BEFORE opening cliente.html. link-cliente is a <span>; read via textContent then regex op=([A-Za-z0-9\-_]+). To verify reopen: after btn-fechar-modal click, poll #video-ecra.srcObject != null and #video-espera.classList.contains('oculto'). videoWidth was 320 in test env (canvas downscale), > 0 is sufficient. All 6/6 checks: cycle-0 first open, 3 close+reopen cycles, btn-pedir-reconexao, click #video-ecra -> circulo-toque (0->1 on cliente).
rca_of_the_issue: Previously, after fecharModal() closed pc but did not reset remotoPronto/iceQueue/srcObject, and old ontrack/onicecandidate handlers remained bound to the closed pc instance; the next abrirVer() reused stale state so a fresh offer/answer never resulted in srcObject being reassigned. Fix binds handlers to a local pcLocal reference and always resets state (remotoPronto=false, iceQueue=[], srcObject=null) both on open and on close, plus re-emits tecnico:ver AND tecnico:pedir-reconexao to force a new offer.
